document.text: If a permit application lacks a required inspection report, the reviewing officer must request the missing report unless the applicant holds a valid exemption. For example, the officer must ask a workshop applicant for its fire-safety inspection report. Every request for an inspection report, including requests made voluntarily for exempt applicants, must allow at least ten working days for a response.
